uncited: **Inputs:** A leaf voxel node from an octree, representing a unit cube in world space.
**Corner Classification:** Iterate over the 8 corners of the voxel.
**Empty/Full Check:** If the bitmask is `0x00` (all AIR) or `0xFF` (all SOLID), the voxel contains no surface.
**Edge Intersection:** Loop over the 12 edges of the cube.
Extract materials $m_1, m_2$ from the bitmask.
